input.rationale: The Agreement has no limitation-of-liability provision: a full read of the document (development/hosting obligations, fees, term, exclusivity, confidentiality, warranties and general provisions) returns no "aggregate liability", damages exclusion or cap language, and searches for "liability", "damages" and "indemnif" surface only the no-joint-venture clause. Both parties are therefore exposed to unlimited direct and consequential liability, including HDI as hosting provider handling the Company's Content, customer data and Confidential Information. Because the Company pays HDI 30% of Net Sales under Section 3, a fee-based cap is a meaningful base. We insert a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, a mutual exclusion of indirect damages, and uncapped Excluded Claims (confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement), with the Company's payment obligations excluded from the cap. Placement as Section 9(c) keeps the provision within a section that survives termination under Section 10.7.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees or USD 1,000,000) with consequential damages exclusion and uncapped Excluded Claims
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, so both parties are exposed to unlimited and consequential damages; we have added a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the preceding twelve months and USD 1,000,000, together with a mutual exclusion of indirect damages. Consistent with our playbook, confidentiality/data protection, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement claims sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations under Sections 3 and 4.2 are not treated as capped damages. We can accept a straight 12-month fee cap as a fallback provided those carve-outs remain.

ops.text: (c) Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the fees paid or payable by the Company to HDI under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's obligations to make payments pursuant to Sections 3 and 4.2 shall not be deemed damages subject to this Section 9(c).
